## `labs/http/api_request` { #labs-http-api_request }

Call one operation of an API file directly, and return its answer.

The step builds the request from the document: the method and path of the operation, its placeholders filled from `path_params` and percent-encoded, the query and headers given, `Accept` from the documented answers. A required parameter or body that is missing, or a header value carrying CR or LF, fails the step before anything is sent. The request goes to `base_url` and nowhere else: redirects are not followed, and answers over 10 MiB are refused rather than read. Put `labs/validate/api_response` under `validate:` to check the answer against what the operation documents.

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Also accepts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `headers` | object | no | `{}` | — | Extra HTTP headers merged into the request. |
| `timeout` | number | no | `None` | — | Request timeout in seconds; the test's default is used when omitted. |
| `api` | any | yes | — | — | The API file, written '${{ env.apis.<id> }}'. Recorded by its id and digest, never as the document. |
| `operation` | string | yes | — | — | The operation: its operationId, or 'METHOD /path' exactly as the document writes the path. |
| `path_params` | object | no | `{}` | — | Values of the path's placeholders, by name; each is percent-encoded as one segment. |
| `query` | object | no | `{}` | — | Query parameters, by name; a list repeats the parameter. Plugs in the 'query' that 'security/api_key' returns. |
| `body` | any | no | `None` | — | Request body; an object or list is sent as JSON, text as it is. |
| `content_type` | string | no | `None` | — | Content-Type of the body; omitted, the operation's first documented one (JSON if documented). |
| `accept` | string | no | `None` | — | Accept header; omitted, the media types the operation documents for its 2XX answers. |
| `expect` | integer \| string | no | `None` | — | The answer the test expects: a status (404), a class ('4XX'), 'success' (2XX) or 'error' (400 and up). Another answer fails the step. A request expected to be refused with a 4xx counts as sent wrong on purpose for 'labs/validate/api_errors'. |
| `base_url` | string | no | `None` | — | URL the operation's path is appended to, e.g. 'https://sut.example.com/api'. Omitted, the document's first server URL (absolute http(s) only, its variables at their defaults). |

**Output** — the value assertions and `returns:` read

_Output contract of the API call steps: the answer and the operation it answers._

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status_code` | integer | Status the API answered with. |
| `response_body` | any | Body: parsed JSON for a JSON media type, else text. |
| `response_headers` | object | Response headers, with the casing the server sent. |
| `operation` | [ApiOperationRef](#apioperationref) | The operation called. |

## `labs/http/api_sweep` { #labs-http-api_sweep }

Call many operations of an API file and check every answer against the document.

Safe by default: only GET and HEAD, and a write only when it is listed in `operations` *and* `include_writes` is true. Each operation's required parameters come from `params` (path and query, by name) and `headers`; one with a value missing is skipped and its row says which. Every call goes to `base_url` — the document's per-operation `servers` are never followed, nor are redirects — at most `concurrency` at a time, each within `timeout` and all within `budget_s`. Each answer is checked as `labs/validate/api_response` checks one; the step fails when any is not what its operation documents, and keeps the table either way.

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Also accepts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `headers` | object | no | `{}` | — | Extra HTTP headers merged into the request. |
| `timeout` | number | no | `None` | — | Request timeout in seconds; the test's default is used when omitted. |
| `api` | any | yes | — | — | The API file, written '${{ env.apis.<id> }}'. Recorded by its id and digest, never as the document. |
| `base_url` | string | no | `None` | — | URL every operation's path is appended to; omitted, the document's first server URL. |
| `operations` | list of string | no | `[]` | — | Only these operations (operationId or 'METHOD /path'); a write must be listed here. |
| `tags` | list of string | no | `[]` | — | Only operations with one of these tags. |
| `methods` | list of string | no | `['GET', 'HEAD']` | — | Only operations with one of these methods. |
| `exclude` | list of string | no | `[]` | — | Operations never called. |
| `include_writes` | boolean | no | `False` | — | Call the writes listed in 'operations' (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE); off by default. |
| `params` | object | no | `{}` | — | Path and query parameter values by name, shared by every operation; an operation missing a required one is skipped. |
| `query` | object | no | `{}` | — | Query parameters sent with every call, e.g. the 'query' 'security/api_key' returns. |
| `bodies` | object | no | `{}` | — | Request bodies by operationId (or 'METHOD /path'), for listed writes. |
| `concurrency` | integer | no | `4` | — | Calls in flight at once. |
| `budget_s` | number | no | `300` | — | Seconds the whole sweep may take; calls not started by then are skipped. |

**Output** — the value assertions and `returns:` read

_Output contract of `labs/http/api_sweep`._

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `results` | list of [SweepRow](#sweeprow) | One row per operation, in document order. |
| `called` | integer | Operations called. |
| `passed` | integer | Calls whose answer the operation documents. |
| `failed` | integer | Calls whose answer it does not, or that failed. |
| `skipped` | integer | Operations not called, with the reason in their row. |

## Nested objects

### ApiOperationRef

The operation an answer belongs to.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Also accepts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `api` | string | yes | — | — | Id of the API file, as declared in env.apis. |
| `id` | string | no | `None` | — | operationId, when the document gives one. |
| `method` | string | yes | — | — | HTTP method. |
| `path` | string | yes | — | — | Path template, as the document writes it. |

### SweepRow

One operation of the sweep and what became of it.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Also accepts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | string | yes | — | — | operationId, else 'METHOD /path'. |
| `method` | string | yes | — | — | HTTP method. |
| `path` | string | yes | — | — | Path template. |
| `status` | integer | no | `None` | — | Status answered; none when not called. |
| `verdict` | string | yes | — | — | 'passed', 'failed', 'skipped' or 'error'. |
| `problems` | list of string | no | `[]` | — | What was wrong, or why it was skipped. |
| `duration_ms` | number | no | `0` | — | Time the call took, in milliseconds. |
